lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 11 distinct white vertical line segments are visible on the lateral flank; spacing is narrowest in the anterior region and widens significantly across the mid-torso.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: A visible Y-shaped bifurcation occurs on the third prominent line from the anterior, with the split originating in the upper dorsal third of the torso.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Multiple dashed line segments are visible in the posterior-most region of the torso, failing to span the full vertical distance between the dorsal ridge and ventral fringe.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A high-contrast cluster of approximately 6 white spots is located on the lower posterior haunch, situated above the hock and anterior to the tail base.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Three spots on the mid-haunch align to form a semi-horizontal geometric row.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: The horns exhibit a lyrate curvature, ascending with an initial outward lateral sweep before curving inward and posteriorly at the terminal points.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The pixel distance between the horn tips is approximately 3.0 times the width of a single horn base.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: The high-contrast ivory-colored tips comprise approximately 15-20% of the total visible horn length.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white dorsal mane extending from the nape to the rump; shaggy dark ventral fringe; white facial markings including a chevron between the eyes and circular cheek spots; distinct tan-colored 'socks' on all four lower limbs.
